problem: Counter drafting could retain expensive Dragon/Armored bodies but replace their cheap Chara/Koppi cost reducers with unrelated low-cost answers. Existing cheap-card, race and top-end counts did not preserve that early route.
changes: Recognize established opening reduction support from compiled Chara/Koppi abilities and the seed list, without card-name or matchup-ID checks. Require at least8 matching payload copies per recognized reducer and at least4 source copies to establish a plan.
In fresh matchups, retain up to6 source copies while at least4 original payload copies remain. Existing40-card legality, source colors, race, overlap and other route guards remain active.
Allow observed defeat feedback to replace a failed opening plan. The learning algorithm and public-only feedback collection are unchanged.
Use the existing generated-cache version mechanism forv4; do not delete oldv3 entries or rewrite user decks, history or save formats.
Add isolated-case, concurrency and bounded timeout options to the comparison tool for reproducible split verification. No game AI wall-clock limits or search budgets were changed.

verification.reason: The fresh-opening floor initially constrained a previously failed plan during feedback rebuilding. Disabled the floor once valid observed defeat feedback exists; reran the failed native adaptation and existing feedback regressions.

verification.reason: One parallel case reached the60-second external test limit. Kept completed cases and resolved only that exact case with one worker and a240-second process limit; identical deck, seed and first player were asserted before merging.

baselineRegression.name: baseline-focused
baselineRegression.resolution: The old frozen builder retains fewer than six real reducer copies in the recorded single-seed draft. The corrected builder and real three-mana Val summon tests pass.

baseline-s0.method: Paired real opposing archetypes with recorded CPU lists. Opponent always uses the frozen baseline AI. Build and CPU turn policy are selected independently; compare targetCaseHash for builder comparisons and caseHash when decks must also match. Physical80-card identities checked after every action. Each isolated case has a60-second process safety limit; game rules and AI decisions never use that wall clock.

comparison.interpretation: On six fixed opposing lists, three seeds and both first players, each builder played36 unique comparison cases. Wins increased29 to31, with two improvements and no observed outcome regressions. The two gains are revolution-1 at seed95104 and95407. This is a limited paired sample, not a general win-rate guarantee.

feedbackRegression.initialFailure: defeat feedback rebuilds a legal response and wins the recorded next match first0
feedbackRegression.resolution: Scope opening preservation to fresh matchups; verified normalized loss feedback may change that plan. The native first0 sequence wins after rebuilding again, and public-feedback/idempotence/multiple-loss checks pass.

limitations: The new support estimate recognizes the compiled Chara/Koppi reductions only. Unknown reduction conditions and other opening engines are not claimed to be covered.
Five losses remain in the36-case improved sample. No claim is made that every supported card or opposing archetype has been exhaustively evaluated.

The first attempted revolution-1 case hit the external60-second process limit in a parallel group. Its isolated verification completed in64.198 seconds with a240-second ceiling. The interrupted attempt remains in raw evidence and is not counted as a loss or as an additional completed comparison.
Final feedback scoping did not alter fresh-matchup CPU lists: all six generated lists were checked against the completed game inputs. Turn AI, rules, seed decks and card definitions are unchanged.
Version-keyed learning reuse across application updates remains outside this change. Stored old caches and learning are not deleted.
Historical full npm test and old interrupted long-running groups were not rerun. Previous registration, print and long-test pending items remain intact.
Every command was bounded by the570-second runner. Current-change verification has no unresolved cases after scoped recovery.
